messages:
Noah Kim: Quick question on per-diem for a two-city trip. Fly SFO->LON red-eye arriving 06:30 local, meeting all day, then overnight train to MAN next day and fly home the following morning. How do we claim per-diem for the arrival/return partial days and multi-city legs?
people-ops-bot: Policy summary -> partial travel days are pro-rated: Arrival day = 50% per-diem if arrival after 00:00 and before 12:00 local; full day if you were on-site more than 6 hours for business. Departure day = 50% if leaving before 13:00 local. Check full policy: https://intranet/redwood/te/per-diem (auto-note)
Sara Wallace: We usually apply the local per-diem rates (UK per-diem) for days spent in UK. For train nights between cities, treat as same country lodging day. If travel crosses countries on same calendar day, apply per-diem for where you spent the majority of the day.
Finance Bot: Attaching practical rules we use when auditing expenses:
- Use the local currency rate for per-diem calculation based on country of stay.
- If arrival is an overnight flight (red-eye) and employee works meetings same day, classify as "Arrival - full" when >6 hours of business activity documented.
- For train/overnight sleeper with a bed charge, submit as Lodging; per-diem for that day still applies.
Priya Desai: What about lost receipts? I lost a taxi receipt on arrival night (airport -> hotel) and it was $38. I paid cash.
Tom Hsu: For lost receipts under $50 we can accept a lost-receipt affidavit + card statement or a bank withdrawal slip. Include route (airport -> hotel), approximate amount, and a short note in Concur. Finance will flag if pattern emerges.
Sara Wallace: Also for group dinners: I was on a team dinner where one client covered half and we split the rest on personal cards. Can we submit a split meal?
people-ops-bot: Reminder -> Business meals with clients are reimbursable with names/affiliation. If split across cards, each person submits their portion and attach the restaurant bill + note showing split. If corporate card used, itemize attendees and business purpose.
Priya Desai: Last Q: My partner added onto my booking (same reservation) for convenience. Are spouse charges reimbursable if I used personal card?
Tom Hsu: Spouse or guest travel is non-reimbursable. If the reservation bundled a "companion" fee, provide the itemized receipt showing employee-only portion. We only reimburse the employee's portion of the fare/lodging. If corporate card was used, ensure the guest items are removed before submission or finance will deduct them.
Noah Kim: Great, that helps. I'll document hours for the arrival day to claim full per-diem and file a lost-receipt affidavit for the taxi. Thanks! :thumbsup:
